retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist 1970s album layout featuring a small centered monochromatic portrait surrounded by expansive negative space and quirky, top-heavy display lettering.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a warm, aged-paper background with a small, vertically-oriented black and white portrait of a child centered in the frame. The top third contains heavy, stylized display text with irregular baselines and mixed-case characteristics.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme negative space framing a small central subject
High-contrast black typography against a cream/off-white field
Monochromatic photographic texture within a thin black border
coreInvariants: Off-white or aged paper texture background
Black ink only for graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small rectangular portrait centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 15% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The centered portrait serves as the primary anchor, while the bold top text provides a secondary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top text, drop down to the central portrait, and then expand into the surrounding negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 80% of the canvas is empty, creating a sense of intimacy and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value background with high contrast black elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and aged paper tones

letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent stroke widths with heavy horizontal bars
Small decorative elements like dots or stars integrated into glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with oversized or decorative dots
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative family with varying scales for artist and title.
graphicDevices: Thin black border around the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the top-heavy, rounded, and quirky 70s feel
Matches the hand-drawn, irregular weight of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square off-white aged paper texture with a small, centered black and white grainy portrait of a child looking at the camera, framed by a thin black line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy, hand-drawn black decorative text at the top, featuring irregular baselines and mixed-case letterforms.

verificationChecks: Is the central image small relative to the canvas?
Is the background a warm off-white?
Does the typography look hand-drawn and heavy?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image is perfectly square.
Check that the central portrait is monochromatic.
Verify the text is solid black without digital gradients.
Confirm the negative space feels intentional and expansive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Small centered B&W photo + Expansive cream negative space + Heavy 70s decorative display type at top = Folk Revival Aesthetic
